name: race-lines
title: Race Lines
description: Multi-series activity line chart with crosshair, sorted tooltip, and draw-in animation.

meta.question: Who is pulling ahead over time, and by how much on any given day?
meta.whenToUse: Daily/weekly activity or usage volumes for a handful of competing entities where per-date comparison matters.
meta.antiUse: Few data points (<8), many series (>6, tooltip and lines turn to spaghetti), or when only the latest value matters (use a ranking bar instead).
